transcript: In the episode Ocarina, we get to see one of Jake's kids, Kim Kil-Wan, take center stage. He shows up and tells Finn and Jake that he bought the deed to their treehouse from Marceline. Why does he do this? Well, he's had enough of Jake acting like a kid all the time and tells him to get a real job. The pair can't afford to pay rent because they've spent all their cash in furniture and meat, so all they can afford is living on a ladder. And then he remembers he buried some gold in the front yard of the treehouse. After digging it out, Kim Kil-Wan tells him that it was buried in his property, therefore it's his. Then we get this line from Finn. I'm gonna be frank here. Your son's a real-time j- So they secretly follow him to his home and can see that the guy is rich. Jake then gives his son a gift, an ocarina. Kim Kyeol-hwan has a change of heart and accepts the ocarina as legal trade and gives them back the deed. While a lot of people interpret this episode as Jake's inability to change, I think it's important to note how much of an effect Jake has had in the land of Ooo. Both of them are considered Oo's greatest heroes. If Jake stopped and got a job, then he would have to say goodbye to being a hero. Make sure to click right here for the full video.
